Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary (parent), molecule_hierarchy, molecule_dictionary (child), compound_structures, compound_records, activities, assays, docs, target_dictionary. Join: parent to child via molecule_hierarchy (parent_molregno = parent.molregno, molregno = child.molregno). child to structures via molregno. child to records via molregno. records to activities via record_id. activities to assays via assay_id. activities to docs via doc_id. assays to target_dictionary via tid. Filter: parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3716726'. target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL375'. activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Sort: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
